title: Modem
lede: Modem watches support tickets, chat communities and sales calls for product problems, then files a ticket, hands the issue to a coding agent or escalates it, and tells customers once the fix ships.

points: Monitors support tickets, sales calls, Slack and Discord, and raises an alert within minutes of a problem appearing.
Can open tickets in Linear, Jira or GitHub, pass the problem to a coding agent, or escalate over Slack or email.
Follows up with the customers who reported a problem when its fix goes out.
Collected feedback becomes a graph an agent can query, for prompts such as what customers are struggling with.
Commenters asked whether follow-ups reply in the original channel, can be reviewed first, and who checks an agent's fix.

sections.text: Product teams whose user feedback is scattered across many tools and slowed by manual escalation; the team says the free plan suits most indie developers.
Usage-based with unlimited seats and a free plan. X monitoring and Gong or Fathom call recording need a paid plan, and new accounts get a two-week trial of it.
